description_en: Delete a speech recognition quality check task
description_zh: 删除语音识别检测任务
name: DeletePrecisionTask

parameters.help_en: A complete JSON string. For details, see the input parameter description below
parameters.help_zh: 完整JSON字符串信息，具体内容参见以下详细信息
parameters.name: json_str

Code.description_en: The result code. A value of 200 indicates success. Any other value indicates failure. Use this field to identify the cause of failure
Code.description_zh: 结果代码，200表示成功，若为别的值则表示失败，调用方可根据此字段判断失败原因

Message.description_en: The error message if the request fails. If the request succeeds, the value is successful
Message.description_zh: 出错时表示出错详情，成功时为successful

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request succeeded. A value of true means success. A value of false or null means failure
Success.description_zh: 请求是否成功，调用方可根据此字段来判断请求是否成功：true表示成功；false/null表示失败
